item.title: The Rainbow Ball returns
item.description: The EFL and PUMA are proud to announce the return of the iconic Rainbow Ball for a third consecutive year, supporting Football v Homophobia’s Month of Action and reinforcing the message that football is for everyone. Serving as a powerful symbol of inclusion, the PUMA Rainbow Ball will feature across all Sky Bet EFL matches from 20 February to 1 March.
